vendorDescription: SAP S/4HANA is an intelligent ERP system built on the SAP HANA in-memory database. It provides real-time processing across finance, procurement, manufacturing, supply chain, and sales.

features.name: SD Order Management
features.description: End-to-end sales order processing with automated pricing, ATP checking, and multi-channel order capture including EDI and customer portals.

features.name: FSCM Credit Management
features.description: Real-time credit exposure monitoring with automated order blocking, credit limit management, and risk-class-based segmentation across all business units.

features.name: Billing & e-Invoicing
features.description: Automated billing document creation with global tax determination, multi-format invoice output, and e-invoicing compliance for 60+ countries.

features.name: FSCM Collections & Dispute Management
features.description: Intelligent collections worklist with automated dunning, dispute case management, and promise-to-pay tracking integrated with accounts receivable.

features.name: Cash Application & Bank Integration
features.description: Automated bank statement import with ML-assisted payment matching, lockbox processing, and real-time accounts receivable clearing.

features.name: SAP Sourcing & Contract Management
features.description: Strategic sourcing with RFx management, supplier evaluation, and contract lifecycle management integrated with purchase order processing.

features.name: Purchase to Pay
features.description: Automated requisition-to-payment processing with three-way matching, supplier invoice verification, and payment run management.

features.name: Supplier Collaboration Portal
features.description: Self-service supplier portal for order confirmation, delivery notification, invoice submission, and performance reporting.

features.name: Production Planning & Execution (PP/DS)
features.description: Constraint-based production planning with shop floor execution, capacity levelling, and real-time production order confirmation.

features.name: Extended Warehouse Management (EWM)
features.description: Advanced warehouse management with wave picking, task interleaving, slotting optimisation, and real-time inventory visibility.

features.name: Integrated Business Planning (IBP)
features.description: Cloud-based demand sensing, supply planning, and S&OP with real-time collaboration and scenario simulation.

features.name: Quality Management (QM)
features.description: Inspection planning, results recording, defect management, and quality notifications integrated across inbound, in-process, and outbound flows.

features.name: Universal Journal (FICO)
features.description: Single source of financial truth combining general ledger, cost accounting, asset accounting, and profitability analysis in one unified journal.

features.name: Group Reporting & Consolidation
features.description: Real-time financial consolidation with intercompany elimination, currency translation, and statutory reporting for multi-entity groups.

features.name: Treasury & Cash Management
features.description: Centralised cash position management, bank account management, and payment factory with real-time liquidity forecasting.
